notes: Behavioral layer. Each case names the skill under test and the behavior that must hold. Run per skill-creator step 5.

evals.prompt: the login redirect is sending people to /dashboard instead of back to where they were. fix it
evals.expected_output: Classified bounded and announced as such. No spec page written, no plan page written, no question loop. Hands to implement.
assertions: announces the tier before doing anything else

evals.prompt: i want to add a label template system to the kilgus app so users can save and reuse label layouts
evals.expected_output: Classified architectural. Searches gbrain for prior kilgus decisions before asking anything. Runs the question loop one question per message. Does not write the spec page until the design has been approved in sections.
assertions: queries gbrain before asking the first question
asks exactly one question per message
does not write the spec page before presenting a design
asks how Hunter wants it verified

evals.prompt: [after a spec has been presented] ok
evals.expected_output: Treats a bare 'ok' as non-affirmative. Asks again rather than advancing to dev-flow:plan.
Waves derived from affected-set disjointness, not file lists. Two tasks whose depth-1 sets intersect must land in different waves even when their file lists do not overlap.
assertions: places tasks with intersecting depth-1 sets in different waves
does not cap wave width at 3 or 5
every brief's DECIDED block contains no open decisions
writes handoff.md and stops without invoking implement

evals.expected_output: Resumes at wave 2 rather than wave 1. Uses at most 3 slots regardless of how many tasks the wave holds. Extras queue.
assertions: resumes at the wave named in handoff.md
queues tasks beyond slot count rather than spawning more slots
dispatches review as each task returns, not after the whole wave

evals.prompt: [a task agent returns Status: complete with no Gauntlet section]
evals.expected_output: Rejects the completion. Does not merge, does not advance the wave.
assertions: does not accept the task as complete
does not merge the task branch

evals.prompt: [branch with all waves merged] review the build
evals.expected_output: Runs /simplify before the specialist fan-out, re-runs the gauntlet after it, dispatches at most 3 specialists, and drops findings that lack a concrete failure scenario.

evals.prompt: [plan Verification section names serve-sim] verify and ship
evals.expected_output: Routes to serve-sim, not to a browser. Records verbatim output. Reads repo CLAUDE.md before pushing and honors a no-push restriction by committing and stopping.
assertions: records verbatim output rather than a summary
commit message contains no AI attribution
